findings.text: pinned_dd4_layer re-reads tests/data-manifest.json and indexes efitpp_validator_layers itself, duplicating nova/imas/validator_case.py:74 load_case_record, which owns MANIFEST_PATH, RECORD_KEY and the layers/dd_version record; a manifest schema change would then have two readers to update, and the fix is to call load_case_record('iter_corsica_130506').

The assertion compares two calls of the test's own _relation helper with values the test supplies, and the 11-to-17 invariance it claims holds for either overall sign because sigma_bp and the derivative flip together, so this assertion can never redden on the sign it is presented beside; the transform-factor assertions at :104-106 are the only independent part.

The measurement header names revision ac37a2561, but that revision lacks region_integrals and extraction_roundtrip (added in 38ab2bb7a) and measure.json's shell rows lack the 'physical' key head emits, so the revision named beside the source-digit table cannot reproduce the artifact it labels; the numbers are still corroborated by the head test for the DD4 slopes and by the edge-consistency node's independent integrals.

The recorded gate result reads '2 passed, 1 xfailed in 8.55s' while the cited gate.log summary line reads '2 passed, 1 xfailed in 7.02s'; the count and exit status are right and the wall time is transcribed from a different run of the same command.

single_dd4_layer converts the pinned layer into $TMPDIR/dd4-layer and nothing removes it, so the batch node keeps a converted reference layer after the job exits, against the fleet rule that a job removes what it wrote to /tmp.
